description: Grow and text your Shopify store's SMS subscribers in Postscript: add, find, tag and opt out subscribers, text them, send events to flows, and start workflows when someone opts in, opts out or texts the shop.

postscript_email_collected_trigger.description: Runs when a Postscript popup collects someone's email, whether or not they also sign up for texts. Postscript tells Lodol through a webhook Lodol sets up for you.

postscript_incoming_message_trigger.description: Runs when someone texts the shop. Keyword sign-ups and opt-in or opt-out replies may not start it. Postscript tells Lodol through a webhook Lodol sets up for you.

output.is_opt_out: Whether the text opted them out.

postscript_subscriber_opted_in_trigger.description: Runs when someone confirms they want the shop's marketing texts and becomes a subscriber. Subscribers who joined before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.can_send_promotional: Whether the shop may text them promotions.
output.can_send_transactional: Whether the shop may text them order updates.
output.email: Their email, if Postscript has one.
output.shopify_customer_id: The Shopify customer they are linked to, if any.

postscript_subscriber_opted_out_trigger.description: Runs when a subscriber stops the shop's texts, such as by replying STOP. Postscript tells Lodol through a webhook Lodol sets up for you.

postscript_subscriber_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a subscriber changes, such as new tags, properties or an opt-out, and when one joins. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.can_send_promotional: Whether the shop may text them promotions.
output.can_send_transactional: Whether the shop may text them order updates.
output.email: Their email, if Postscript has one.
output.shopify_customer_id: The Shopify customer they are linked to, if any.
